name: Prompting and Evaluating Multimodal AI Models
outcome: Design and evaluate a reproducible multimodal AI research workflow.
description: Use existing vision-language models to investigate image-based research questions. With AMMICO as the reference implementation, compare prompts and model backends, validate results against human annotations, and export documented results for analysis.
external: Basic Python and notebook familiarity; approved endpoint access; ORCID for the Jupyter4NFDI setup.
prior: Basic Python and familiarity with Jupyter notebooks (proposed)
Access to an approved model endpoint; registered ORCID account if using the Jupyter4NFDI setup
learn: Translate research questions into visual prompts and refine them against observed outputs
Run image summarization or visual question answering in batches and export results
Compare model and prompt configurations against human-coded references
Record prompts, model provenance and failures; assess data licensing and confidentiality
tools: Approved local or institutional model endpoint
modules: Vision-language models: capabilities and failure modes
Prompt design and reproducible workflow setup
Image batch processing and export with AMMICO
moduleDescriptions: Identify VLM inputs, outputs, prompt sensitivity and common visual errors.
Turn research questions into consistent visual questions and configure a model endpoint.
Run AMMICO on a small image collection and export results to CSV.
Compare model outputs with human labels; document errors, refusals and provenance.
prerequisiteRationale: F02 introduces prompt iteration and output verification; R02 extends them to image and text inputs.
